names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 11 martie, «Sfântul Sfinţit Mucenic Pionie, preotul din Smirna».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 11 Μαρτίου, «Άγιοι Πιόνιος ο Πρεσβύτερος και Σαβίνα», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's second heading for the Julian 11 March on pravoslavno.rs, „Свети мученици Пионије и други с њим.“, with the rank word мученици left off and Свети, which is not a rank. The heading gives no epithet and does not name Smyrna, which this folder's English name carries and which the body's first words supply.

death.note: doxologia.ro prints the reign twice and not alike: early in the life «pe vremea împărăției lui Deciu (245-251)», and at the end «pe vremea împărăției lui Deciu (249-251)». The interval is the wider of the two readings the page itself gives; it states no year for the martyrdom, only the day.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 11 martie — «Sfântul Sfinţit Mucenic Pionie, preotul din Smirna»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 11ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιοι Πιόνιος ο Πρεσβύτερος και Σαβίνα»

attestations.note: The page puts him under Decius «(249 - 251 μ.Χ.)» and a presbyter of the Church of Smyrna; the corpus's interval is doxologia's «245-251» and is left as it stands. It names Polemon the priest of the idols, Elpidios the archon of the city and the proconsul Kontylianos, and says his synaxis was kept at the Lithostroton, where a church stood in his name. The line pairs him with a Sabina, of whom the same page says «Η μνήμη της Αγίας Σαβίνας είναι άγνωστη στους Συναξαριστές» and only that «φαίνεται» she suffered with him; she is left undrafted on that ground.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 24.03.2026 (11. март ст. ст.) — „Свети мученици Пионије и други с њим.“

attestations.note: The day's second entry. The heading says „и други с њим“ — and the others with him — and neither the heading nor the body names one of them, so the others took no row and no folder; the Greek line this folder already quotes names a Sabina with him, and the Prologue does not. The Prologue gives the year 250, which falls inside the interval this folder already holds, 245 to 251, and narrower than it, so nothing was changed. The entry names him as the writer of the life of Polycarp of Smyrna, which took a `related` row in both directions on the footing `troadius` already relates to `nicodemus-the-hagiorite`.
